trial.guildOnly: Use this command inside the server where you want the trial.
trial.noPermission: Only the server owner (or someone with Administrator) can redeem a trial code.
trial.failed: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact the team.
trial.granted: Plan **{plan}** unlocked for **{days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}**.
trial.guildCovered: **{guild}** is already covered — just turn on the modules on the dashboard.
trial.guildNotCovered: ⚠️ The trial is active on your account, but **{guild}** couldn't be covered automatically (the server is already on another account). Pick the server on the dashboard, under **Plan › Pro Servers**.
trial.afterEnd: When the trial ends, paid modules are turned off — your settings stay saved.
